kind.description: Only these two. `extract` is spawned from a search result, `hypothesize` is scheduled by code once a branch has enough facts, `verify` comes from a hypothesis, `synthesize` belongs to the render phase. A decomposer creating one of those makes a task nothing feeds.

rationale.description: Why this child is needed to answer the parent. Breadth is unbounded by design; this obligation is one of the two things bounding it.

depends_on_index.description: Positions in this same `children` array. Indices, not ids: a decomposer has no graph access, so any id here would be invented.

blocks_index.description: Positions in `children` whose validity rests on this assumption. Drives the invalidation cascade if it is later refuted.
